title: How to Prevent Foil Cracking After Folding and Creasing

seo.title: How to Prevent Foil Cracking After Folding and Creasing

content:
Foil can look good on a flat sheet but fail after the box is folded or assembled. This is why paper box foil should always be checked after the full finishing process.

## Why It Happens

If the foil area is too close to a fold line or corner, the surface may break during box forming. Weak adhesion on printed or laminated paper can also become visible only after folding.

Some special-effect foils are less flexible than general paper foils, so the foil grade should match the package structure.

## How to Reduce Risk

Keep important foil details away from fold lines when possible. If the design must cross a fold, test it on the real material. After stamping, fold and assemble the sample before approval.

## FAQ

### Why does the flat sample pass but the box fail?

The final box creates stress that the flat sheet does not show.
